headline: Court grants 3-day remand for suspect in Mirpur Jubodal worker killing
summary: Chanchal Molla, arrested with a foreign pistol, will be interrogated to uncover the motive and location of other fugitives.
details: A Dhaka court has granted a three-day remand for Chanchal Molla, who was arrested in connection with the killing of Jubodal worker Yusuf Ali in Mirpur.
caption:
A suspect arrested with a foreign pistol has been remanded for three days following a fatal shooting in Mirpur.

A Dhaka court has granted a three-day remand for Chanchal Molla, who was arrested in connection with the killing of Jubodal worker Yusuf Ali in Mirpur.

Source: Prothom Alo, Somoy News

headline_marked: Around [[9,600 people die from drowning]] each year in Bangladesh, says WHO
headline: Around 9,600 people die from drowning each year in Bangladesh, says WHO
summary: The World Health Organization reports a staggering annual death toll from drowning, highlighting a critical public health challenge in the country.
details: The World Health Organization (WHO) has revealed that approximately 9,600 people lose their lives to drowning every year in Bangladesh.
This high number of fatalities underscores a significant and persistent public health crisis that affects thousands of families across the country.
The data highlights the urgent need for improved water safety measures, drowning prevention strategies, and enhanced emergency response systems.
Experts suggest that many of these deaths are preventable through community-based interventions and increased public awareness about the water-related risks.
caption:
9,600 deaths every year. The scale of drowning fatalities in Bangladesh is a critical crisis.

The World Health Organization (WHO) has revealed that approximately 9,600 people lose their lives to drowning every year in Bangladesh.

This high number of fatalities underscores a significant and persistent public health crisis that affects thousands of families across the country.

The data highlights the urgent need for improved water safety measures, drowning prevention strategies, and enhanced emergency response systems.

Experts suggest that many of these deaths are preventable through community-based interventions and increased public awareness about the water-related risks.

#Bangladesh #PublicHealth #WHO #WaterSafety #DrowningPrevention

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News
